tasks.label: 14Y: Install Dependencies
tasks.detail: Install the application dependency tree and generate package-lock.json.

tasks.label: 14Y: Typecheck
tasks.detail: Run the strict TypeScript verification gate.

tasks.label: 14Y: Production Build
tasks.detail: Create the Next.js standalone production build.

tasks.label: 14Y: Build and Verify
tasks.detail: Default VS Code build task: typecheck, test, then production build.

tasks.label: 14Y: Seed Synthetic Medplum Data
tasks.detail: Seed or update the synthetic Patient, ServiceRequest, and DocumentReference. Requires .env.local.

tasks.label: 14Y: Demo Preflight
tasks.detail: Run static verification gates, then seed the synthetic Medplum tenant. Requires .env.local.

tasks.label: 14Y: Start Development Server
tasks.detail: Start Next.js development mode at http://localhost:3000.

tasks.label: 14Y: Docker Build
tasks.detail: Build the local production container image.

tasks.label: 14Y: Docker Run
tasks.detail: Run the local container with .env.local on port 3000.

tasks.label: 14Y: AWS Install CDK Dependencies
tasks.detail: Install the AWS CDK infrastructure dependency tree.

tasks.label: 14Y: AWS Build CDK
tasks.detail: Compile the AWS CDK TypeScript project.

tasks.label: 14Y: AWS CDK Synth
tasks.detail: Synthesize CloudFormation. Requires AWS credentials and MEDPLUM_SECRET_ARN in the VS Code process environment.

tasks.label: 14Y: AWS Deploy
tasks.detail: Deploy the load-balanced ECS Fargate service. Requires AWS credentials and MEDPLUM_SECRET_ARN.
